title: Health risk assessment of nitrate in groundwater resources of Iranshahr using Monte Carlo simulation and geographic information system (GIS)
author: Shalyari, Alinejad, et al.

steps.title: Purge wells before sampling
steps.instruction: Pump each dug‑well for about 50 minutes to remove stagnant water prior to sample collection.

steps.title: Rinse sample containers
steps.instruction: Rinse each 1 L polyethylene container four times with deionized water before use.

steps.title: Collect groundwater samples
steps.instruction: Collect a total of 66 groundwater samples (1 L each) from the rural wells after purging.

steps.title: Label and store samples
steps.instruction: Label each sample, store at 4 °C, and keep until transport to the laboratory.

steps.title: Transport to laboratory
steps.instruction: Transport the refrigerated samples to the laboratory for chemical analysis of essential parameters according to Standard Methods for Examination of Water and Wastewater.

steps.title: Statistical data analysis
steps.instruction: Perform Pearson correlation analysis using IBM SPSS Version 16.00 and conduct significance tests at the 95 % confidence level.
